title: PaintEZ of Gainesville Alternative: Ceilings & Walls
description: Comparing PaintEZ of Gainesville with Precision Paint Experts for popcorn ceiling or wallpaper removal? What to ask about dust, drywall, and repainting.
h1: PaintEZ of Gainesville vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Removing a popcorn ceiling or old wallpaper is messier than painting, and the prep decides the finish. Here is what to ask any contractor before the scraping starts.

questions: Should a popcorn ceiling be tested before removal?
How do you remove wallpaper without damaging drywall?

body: PaintEZ of Gainesville is one of the painting companies Gainesville homeowners may be considering, and Precision Paint Experts also works throughout the city. We will not describe other businesses. This page focuses on two jobs that usually come before the paint: taking down textured ceilings and stripping old wallpaper.

Both tasks can leave behind gouged drywall, torn paper facing, or a fine layer of dust over everything in the room. How a contractor plans to contain the mess and repair the surface afterward is the real comparison.
Some older textured ceilings may contain asbestos, so testing should come before any scraping. Our article on popcorn ceilings and asbestos explains what to know first.

Precision Paint Experts offers ceiling painting and popcorn removal, including dustless removal for homes where the family is staying put. Once the texture is down, the ceiling is repaired and repainted so it reads as a smooth, even plane.

Once the old texture is gone, the bare ceiling often reveals seams, tape lines, and old patches that the popcorn had hidden. These are skim-coated or patched before primer so the finished ceiling looks smooth under raking light from windows and fixtures. That repair step should appear on any estimate you compare, because a ceiling that is scraped but not repaired will show every flaw once it is painted.

The hardest part of wallpaper removal is often what is behind it. Paper hung over unprimed drywall can pull the face of the board off with it. Our guide on removing wallpaper without wrecking the drywall walks through the steps.
After the paper and adhesive are off, damaged areas are patched through our drywall repair service, primed, and painted, so you are not left with a stripped wall waiting for another trade.

Some walls have more than one layer of paper, or paper that has been painted over, which slows removal and can affect the price. A crew lead will check a few spots during the walkthrough to see what is underneath before the estimate is written, so the quote reflects the wall you actually have rather than a guess.
Ask each contractor to confirm these in writing:
bullets: Is asbestos testing addressed before a textured ceiling is disturbed?
How are floors, furniture, and HVAC returns protected from dust?
Is drywall repair after removal included, or extra?
Which primer and topcoat follow, and how many coats?
Can we stay in the house while rooms are worked on?

body: Our estimates list surfaces included and excluded, prep, primer and topcoat products, coat count, and schedule. Nothing is added later without written approval. Clients do not need to leave the home; crews protect furniture and work room by room, and low-VOC options are available. Request a free estimate for your ceilings or walls.
Most single rooms take about a day of painting once removal and repairs are done, and the estimate shows how many days the whole sequence should take.

faqs.q: Do you offer dustless popcorn ceiling removal?
faqs.a: Yes. Dustless removal is one of our ceiling services, suited to homes that stay occupied during the work.

faqs.q: What happens if the drywall is damaged when wallpaper comes off?
faqs.a: We repair and patch the drywall, then prime and paint, as part of the scoped work listed on the estimate.

faqs.q: Is the ceiling painted after the texture is removed?
faqs.a: Yes. Ceiling painting follows removal, and the product and coat count are on the estimate.
